statement: ∀ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M → (∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (v : KdVPlan.Path) (a b : ℝ), 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 → KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b → b-a ≤ 1 → KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v ≤ 1 → KdVPlan.StabilityEstimates C gamma τ a b f v) → ∃ δ K : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < K ∧ ∀ (τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (v : KdVPlan.Path) (a b : ℝ), 0 < τ → τ ≤ δ/2 → KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b → b-a ≤ δ → KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v ≤ 1 → KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v ≤ 2*KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.err τ f v a)+K*δ*τ^gamma

obtain ⟨C,hC,hs⟩ := hbase
obtain ⟨N,δ,K,hN,hδ,hd1,hK,ha⟩ := @yui_aux_0002 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T008 h_T009 h_T013 C hC

intro τ L f v a b ht htδ htraj hg hlen he
have ht1 : τ ≤ 1 := by linarith
have hp := (hs τ L f v a b ht ht1 htraj hg (hlen.trans hd1) he).2 N hN
apply ha (b-a) τ (KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v) (KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.err τ f v a)) (sub_nonneg.mpr hg.2.1) hlen ht htδ
· apply Real.sSup_nonneg

  exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
· exact hp.2.2.2
